title: एनपीएलः ठूला विदेशी नामबिनै बलियो देखिएको साविक विजेता लुम्बिनी

No ads found for this position काठमाडौँ । नेपाल प्रिमियर लिग (एनपीएल)को तेस्रो संस्करणमा साविक विजेता लुम्बिनी लायन्स उपाधि रक्षाको अभियानमा छ । टोलीले अहिलेसम्मको यात्रामा हारको सामना गर्नुपरेको छैन । अन्य फ्रेन्चाइज टोलीले विश्व क्रिकेटमा चर्चित विदेशी खेलाडी भित्र्याएर आफ्नो शक्ति देखाउन खोज्दा लुम्बिनी भने टिमको सन्तुलन, नेपाली खेलाडीको प्रदर्शन र कप्तान रोहित पौडेलको नेतृत्वका कारण बलियो देखिएको छ । एनपीएल सुरू हुनुअघि चर्चित विदेशी खेलाडी ल्याउन उदासिनता देखाएको भनेर लुम्बिनी लायन्सका फ्यानहरू असन्तुष्ट थिए । एनपीएलमा काठमाडौं गोर्खाजसँग डेभिड वार्नर, पोखरा एभेन्जर्ससँग शाकिब अल हसन, जनकपुर बोल्ट्ससँग मोइन अली र जेम्स निसम तथा विराटनगर किंग्ससँग आन्द्रे रसेलजस्ता चर्चित विदेशी खेलाडी छन् । तर, लुम्बिनीले यस्ता ठूला नामको आकर्षणभन्दा मैदानमा नतिजा निकाल्ने क्षमतालाई प्राथमिकता दिएको देखिन्छ । लुम्बिनीको विदेशी खेलाडी समूहमा अस्ट्रेलियाका डार्सी सर्ट, श्रीलंकाका निरोशन डिकवेला, नामिबियाका रुबेन ट्रम्पलम्यान, बंगलादेशका शमिम हुसेन र अमेरिकाका शाड्ली भान साल्कविक छन् । उनीहरू विश्व क्रिकेटका अत्यधिक चर्चित नाम नभए पनि टोलीको आवश्यकताअनुसार भूमिका निर्वाह गर्न सक्ने खेलाडी हुन् । लुम्बिनीले अहिलेसम्म उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शनसहित अपराजित यात्रा गरिरहेको छ । पहिलो खेलमा सुदूरपश्चिम रोयल्सलाई सात विकेटले पराजित गरेको थियो । त्यसपछि चितवन राइनोजसँगको खेल वर्षाका कारण रद्द भएर अंक बाँड्नुपर्यो । पोखरा एभेन्जर्सलाई आठ विकेटले हराएको लुम्बिनीले जनकपुर बोल्ट्सविरुद्ध १६ रनको जित निकाल्यो । लुम्बिनी चार खेलबाट तीन जित र एक अनिर्णीत नतिजासहित सात अंक जोडेर अंकतालिकाको शीर्ष स्थानमा छ । लुम्बिनीको सफलतामा कप्तान रोहित पौडेलको भूमिका महत्त्वपूर्ण छ । नेपाली राष्ट्रिय टोलीको नेतृत्व गरिसकेका रोहितले ब्याटिङबाट योगदान दिनुका साथै खेलको परिस्थितिअनुसार टोलीलाई अघि बढाउने जिम्मेवारी सम्हालिरहेका छन् । पोखराविरुद्ध उनले अविजित ४७ रन बनाएका थिए । जनकपुरविरुद्ध पनि उनले ३८ रन जोडे । यी दुई इनिङ्सले कप्तानले महत्त्वपूर्ण समयमा ब्याटिङको जिम्मेवारी लिन सक्ने देखाएका छन् । लुम्बिनीको अर्को बलियो पक्ष नेपाली खेलाडीको सामूहिक योगदान हो । शेर मल्ल र तिलक भण्डारीले स्पिन बलिङमा प्रभाव देखाएका छन् भने आसिफ शेखले ब्याटिङलाई मजबुत बनाएका छन् । सन्दीप जोरा, किशोर महतो, दिलिप नाथ र अन्य नेपाली खेलाडीबाट पनि टोलीले योगदानको अपेक्षा गरेको छ । लुम्बिनीले गत संस्करणको उपाधि जित्दा पनि नेपाली खेलाडीको भूमिका महत्त्वपूर्ण थियो । पहिलो संस्करणमा अंकतालिकाको पुछारमा रहेको टोलीले दोस्रो संस्करणमा उपाधि जितेर आफूलाई बदल्न सक्ने क्षमता प्रमाणित गर्यो । अहिले त्यही सफलताको जगमा तेस्रो संस्करणमा उपाधि जोगाउने चुनौती सामना गरिरहेको छ । एनपीएलमा विदेशी खेलाडीको चर्चा हुनु स्वाभाविक हो । चर्चित खेलाडीको आगमनले प्रतियोगिताको आकर्षण बढाउँछ र समर्थकको ध्यान तान्छ । तर, टी–२० क्रिकेटमा नाम चलेका खेलाडीको उपस्थितिले मात्र जित सुनिश्चित गर्दैन । लुम्बिनीले रोजेका विदेशी खेलाडीलाई हेर्दा टोलीले फरक भूमिका पूरा गर्ने खेलाडीको संयोजन बनाएको देखिन्छ । डार्सी सर्टले ओपनिङ र स्पिन बलिङमा योगदान दिन सक्छन् । डिकवेलाले विकेटकिपिङसँगै ब्याटिङ सम्हाल्छन् । ट्रम्पलम्यानले तीव्र बलिङको जिम्मेवारी लिन्छन् । शमिम हुसेन र शाड्ली भान साल्कविकले अलराउन्ड विकल्प उपलब्ध गराउँछन् । यसले टोलीलाई ब्याटिङ र बलिङ दुवैतर्फ विकल्प दिएको छ । प्रतियोगिताको प्रारम्भिक सफलताका आधारमा लुम्बिनीले उपाधि जित्ने निष्कर्ष निकाल्नु हतार हुनेछ । लिग चरणका बाँकी खेल, प्लेअफको दबाब र विपक्षी टोलीको रणनीतिले यसको वास्तविक परीक्षा लिनेछन् । लुम्बिनीले आगामी खेलमा यही लय कायम राख्नुपर्नेछ । आज काठमाडौं गोर्खाजसँग हुने खेल टोलीका लागि अर्को महत्त्वपूर्ण चुनौती हो । काठमाडौँसँग डेभिड वार्नरजस्ता चर्चित खेलाडी छन् । यस्तो टोलीविरुद्ध लुम्बिनीले आफ्नो सामूहिक खेललाई निरन्तरता दिन सके त्यसले उपाधि रक्षा अभियानलाई थप बलियो बनाउनेछ । कप्तान करण केसी बल र ब्याट दुवैमा खतरनाक बन्न सक्छन् । दुवै टोली २ अंक जोड्ने ध्याउन्नमा हुनेछन् । Kathmandu. Defending champions Lumbini Lions are on a mission to defend their title in the third edition of the Nepal Premier League (NPL). The team has not faced any defeat in its journey so far. While other franchise teams have tried to show their strength by bringing in famous foreign players in world cricket, Lumbini has emerged strong due to the balance of the team, the performance of Nepali players and the leadership of captain Rohit Poudel. Lumbini Lions fans were unhappy with the lack of interest in bringing in famous foreign players before the start of the NPL. The NPL has famous foreign players like David Warner with Kathmandu Gorkhas, Shakib Al Hasan with Pokhara Avengers, Moeen Ali and James Neesam with Janakpur Bolts, and Andre Russell with Biratnagar Kings. However, Lumbini seems to have prioritized its ability to produce results on the field over the attraction of such big names. Lumbini's foreign player group includes Australia's Darcy Short, Sri Lanka's Niroshan Dickwella, Namibia's Ruben Trumpelman, Bangladesh's Shamim Hussain and America's Shadley Van Salkwick. Although they are not the most famous names in world cricket, they are players who can play a role according to the team's needs. Lumbini has been on an undefeated run with excellent performances so far. In the first match, they defeated Sudurpaschim Royals by seven wickets. Then, the match with Chitwan Rhinos was called off due to rain and the points had to be shared. Lumbini defeated Pokhara Avengers by eight wickets and won by 16 runs against Janakpur Bolts. Lumbini is at the top of the table with seven points from four matches, including three wins and one draw. Captain Rohit Poudel has played a key role in Lumbini's success. Rohit, who has led the Nepali national team, is contributing with his batting and is also responsible for leading the team according to the match situation. He scored an unbeaten 47 against Pokhara. He also scored 38 against Janakpur. These two innings have shown that the captain can take charge of the batting at crucial times. Another strong point for Lumbini is the collective contribution of Nepali players. Sher Malla and Tilak Bhandari have shown an impact in spin bowling, while Asif Sheikh has strengthened the batting. The team also expects contributions from Sandeep Jora, Kishore Mahato, Dilip Nath and other Nepali players. Nepali players played a key role in Lumbini winning the title last season. The team, which was at the bottom of the points table in the first season, proved its ability to turn things around by winning the title in the second season. Now, building on that success, it is facing the challenge of defending the title in the third season. It is natural for foreign players to be talked about in the NPL. The arrival of famous players increases the attractiveness of the tournament and attracts the attention of fans. However, in T20 cricket, the presence of famous players alone does not ensure victory. Looking at the foreign players chosen by Lumbini, it seems that the team has created a combination of players who fulfill different roles. Darcy Short can contribute in opening and spin bowling. Dickwella handles the batting along with wicketkeeping. Trumpelman takes on the responsibility of fast bowling. Shamim Hossain and Shadley van Salkwijk provide all-round options. This has given the team options in both batting and bowling. It would be premature to conclude that Lumbini will win the title based on their initial success in the tournament. The remaining league matches, the pressure of the playoffs, and the strategy of the opposing team will be the real test. Lumbini will have to maintain this momentum in the upcoming matches. Today's match against Kathmandu Gorkhas is another important challenge for the team. Kathmandu has famous players like David Warner. If Lumbini can continue their collective play against such a team, it will further strengthen their title defense campaign. Captain Karan KC can be dangerous with both ball and bat. Both teams will be looking to add 2 points.
